spec:
# Fix Taskboard Worker Launch For Rot 18 Replace The Competing

## Request

> Fix Taskboard worker launch for ROT-18: replace the competing Execute and Start agent actions with one preferred Start agent flow, keep the dedicated Worker page and kanban drag-to-in-progress launch behavior, and handle repositories with no initial commit so users are not blocked by the current raw validation error. Preserve existing uncommitted Taskboard work and verify the resulting UI and execution behavior.

## Goal

Starting work from an issue or Kanban card is a single action that opens the
dedicated Worker page and dispatches managed execution without requiring the
user to understand repository setup.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] [AC-1] Issue details expose one primary `Start agent` action instead of
  separate `Send to agent` and `Execute` actions.
- [ ] [AC-2] `Start agent`, a Kanban card play action, and moving a card into an
  in-progress column all open the dedicated Worker page and dispatch at most
  one managed execution.
- [ ] [AC-3] When the configured repository is valid but has no commits,
  one-click managed execution creates an empty initial commit without staging
  or changing working-tree files, then uses it as the base revision.
- [ ] [AC-4] When managed execution is disabled, `Start agent` retains the
  existing local composer handoff.
- [ ] [AC-5] Invalid or inaccessible repositories still produce actionable
  field-oriented errors.
- [ ] [AC-UI-1] [UI] The Worker page shows launch progress, execution state,
  failures, and a way back to the issue without notification overlays obscuring
  the core work surface.

## Scope

- Taskboard issue-detail and Kanban launch controls.
- Worker-route automatic dispatch behavior.
- Git default resolution for an unborn repository.
- Focused regression coverage and live plugin reload.

## Non-goals

- Automatically staging or committing user files.
- Changing tracker completion authority or verification gates.
- Redesigning Symphony runtime internals or tracker synchronization.
- Changing external tracker status merely because an agent starts.

## Verification

- Run focused Taskboard tests for UI routing, one-click dispatch, repository
  bootstrap, and service lifecycle.
- Run the plugin check/build command authorized by the verification matrix.
- Install/reload the local Taskboard plugin and confirm its services are
  running.

## Capability Deltas

See `deltas/taskboard-execution.md`.

requirements.name: Optional execution infrastructure
requirements.contents:
### Requirement: Optional execution infrastructure

Taskboard SHALL expose a single `Start agent` action for beginning work. When
managed execution is enabled, that action SHALL open the dedicated Worker page
and dispatch one managed execution. When it is disabled, the action SHALL use
the existing local composer handoff. Managed execution defaults SHALL preserve
the configured project repository and exact Git revision and SHALL infer a
valid base branch for attached, detached, and unborn project checkouts.

#### Scenario: One-click managed start

- WHEN a user selects `Start agent` for a task with managed execution enabled
- THEN Taskboard opens the Worker page and dispatches that task at most once.

#### Scenario: Existing local handoff

- WHEN managed execution is disabled
- THEN `Start agent` opens the BB composer with the existing sanitized task
  context.

#### Scenario: Unborn repository

- WHEN the configured repository is valid but has no commits
- THEN Taskboard creates one empty initial commit without staging working-tree
  files and uses that commit and the repository's configured branch as the
  managed execution base.

#### Scenario: Kanban work begins

- WHEN a user selects the card play action or moves a card from another state
  into an in-progress column
- THEN Taskboard opens the same Worker flow used by `Start agent`.

#### Scenario: Execution defaults cannot be determined

- WHEN the project source is missing or invalid
- THEN Taskboard names the repository correction required without exposing an
  internal Git subcommand failure.

decisions:
# Decisions

## D-001: One primary issue action

Status: Accepted

### Evidence

Issue detail currently renders `Send to agent` while the embedded execution
panel separately renders `Execute`.

### Options

Keep both controls, or render only `Start agent` with a configuration-aware
destination.

### Chosen approach

Render only `Start agent`; route to Worker when managed execution is enabled
and preserve composer handoff otherwise.

### Trade-offs and risks

The advanced review dialog is no longer the default entry point.

### Verification

Source assertions and live issue-detail inspection.

## D-002: Explicit repository initialization

Status: Accepted

### Evidence

Managed worktrees require a commit, and `executionDefaults` rejects an unborn
repository.

### Options

Keep the error, commit user files, or create an empty commit.

### Chosen approach

Create an empty initial commit only for an explicit one-click start.

### Trade-offs and risks

The repository gains a commit. Disable hooks/signing, supply local commit
identity, never stage files, and assert index/working-tree state in tests.

### Verification

Focused tests using an unborn repository with untracked content.

## D-003: Reuse the Worker route

Status: Accepted

### Evidence

Existing uncommitted work already adds a Worker route and auto-start guard.

### Options

Complete the route or introduce another launch surface.

### Chosen approach

Complete and test the existing route.

### Trade-offs and risks

Route state remains responsible for auto-start intent.

### Verification

Focused execution and UI tests plus live plugin reload.
